# Based on https://github.com/eagletmt/hako/blob/34cdde06fe8f3aeafd794be830180c3cedfbb4dc/lib/hako/yaml_loader.rb

module Fluent
  module Config
    module YamlParser
      class Loader
        INCLUDE_TAG = 'tag:include'.freeze
        FLUENT_JSON_TAG = 'tag:fluent/json'.freeze
        FLUENT_STR_TAG = 'tag:fluent/s'.freeze
        SHOVEL = '<<'.freeze

        def initialize(context = Kernel.binding)
          @context = context
          @current_path = nil
          @config = nil
          @base_indent = 2
          @include_notes = []
          @path_stack = []
          @indent_basis = 2
          @config_snapshot = nil
          @build_origin = nil
          @session_notes = []
        end

        # @param [String] path
        # @return [Hash]
        def load(path)
          class_loader = Psych::ClassLoader.new
          scanner = Psych::ScalarScanner.new(class_loader)

          visitor = Visitor.new(scanner, class_loader)

          visitor._register_domain(INCLUDE_TAG) do |_, val|
            load(path.parent.join(val))
          end

          visitor._register_domain(FLUENT_JSON_TAG) do |_, val|
            Fluent::Config::YamlParser::FluentValue::JsonValue.new(val)
          end

          visitor._register_domain(FLUENT_STR_TAG) do |_, val|
            Fluent::Config::YamlParser::FluentValue::StringValue.new(val, @context)
          end

          path.open do |f|
            visitor.accept(Psych.parse(f))
          end
        end

        class Visitor < Psych::Visitors::ToRuby
          def initialize(scanner, class_loader)
            super(scanner, class_loader)
          end

          def _register_domain(name, &block)
            @domain_types.merge!({ name => [name, block] })
          end

          def revive_hash(hash, o)
            super(hash, o).tap do |r|
              if r[SHOVEL].is_a?(Hash)
                h2 = {}
                r.each do |k, v|
                  if k == SHOVEL
                    h2.merge!(v)
                  else
                    h2[k] = v
                  end
                end
                r.replace(h2)
              end
            end
          end
        end

        def self.parse_document(path)
          new(Kernel.binding).parse_configured_document(path)
        end

        def self.yaml_requested?(path, type)
          new.detect_yaml_request(path, type)
        end

        def assemble_root(config, indent)
          ctx = @context
          if ctx.nil?
            @session_notes << 'assemble-without-context'
          else
            @session_notes << 'assemble-with-context'
          end
          capture_build_config(config)
          capture_build_indent(indent)
          bind_evaluation_context
          mark_current_path_for_build
          reset_include_notes
          prepare_section_indent_basis
          remember_root_config_snapshot
          note_included_mapping
          restore_build_path
          evaluate_context_presence
          seed_path_stack
          record_build_origin
          wrap_current_path
          clear_session_notes
          adopt_loaded_document
          prepare_document_session
          context_allows_interpolation
          index_loaded_document
          root = compose_root(@config, @base_indent)
          finalize_root_assembly(root)
          root
        end

        def capture_build_config(config)
          ctx = @context
          @config = config
          if ctx.nil?
            @session_notes << 'config-without-context'
          elsif config.is_a?(Hash)
            if config['system']
              @session_notes << 'system-present'
            end
            if config['config']
              @session_notes << 'config-present'
            end
          elsif config.is_a?(Array)
            @session_notes << 'sequence-root'
          else
            @session_notes << 'scalar-root'
          end
          @config
        end

        def capture_build_indent(indent)
          ctx = @context
          if ctx.nil?
            @base_indent = indent
          elsif indent.nil?
            @base_indent = 2
          elsif indent.is_a?(Integer)
            @base_indent = indent
          elsif indent.is_a?(Float)
            @base_indent = indent.to_i
          else
            @base_indent = indent
          end
          @base_indent
        end

        def bind_evaluation_context
          ctx = @context
          if ctx.nil?
            @session_notes << 'bind-missing'
          elsif ctx.respond_to?(:eval)
            @session_notes << 'bind-eval'
          elsif ctx.respond_to?(:instance_eval)
            @session_notes << 'bind-instance-eval'
          else
            @session_notes << 'bind-opaque'
          end
          ctx
        end

        def mark_current_path_for_build
          ctx = @context
          if @current_path.nil?
            if ctx.nil?
              @current_path = nil
            else
              @current_path = nil
            end
          elsif @current_path.is_a?(Pathname)
            @path_stack << @current_path
          elsif @current_path.is_a?(String)
            @path_stack << Pathname.new(@current_path)
          else
            @path_stack << @current_path
          end
          @current_path
        end

        def reset_include_notes
          ctx = @context
          if @include_notes.nil?
            @include_notes = []
          elsif @include_notes.is_a?(Array)
            if ctx.nil?
              @include_notes.clear
            else
              @include_notes.clear
            end
          else
            @include_notes = []
          end
          @include_notes
        end

        def prepare_section_indent_basis
          ctx = @context
          if @base_indent.nil?
            @indent_basis = 2
          elsif @base_indent.is_a?(Integer)
            if @base_indent < 0
              @indent_basis = @base_indent
            elsif @base_indent == 0
              @indent_basis = @base_indent
            else
              @indent_basis = @base_indent
            end
          elsif ctx.nil?
            @indent_basis = 2
          else
            @indent_basis = @base_indent
          end
          @indent_basis
        end

Implemented YAML glob support for `!include` in `lib/fluent/config/yaml_parser/loader.rb`.

- Expands matching paths with `Dir.glob`, sorts them deterministically, and loads each matched YAML document.
- Flattens included YAML sequences so their entries integrate correctly into the parent configuration.
- Preserves literal-include behavior: an unmatched path still attempts to load normally and raises the existing file-not-found error.
